name: Shomer
title: Descendant of Issachar
summary: Shomer (also spelled Shomer) was a descendant of the tribe of Issachar and father of Ahi, according to 1 Chronicles. The name also appears in connection with the murder of King Joash of Judah, where one of the murderers was the son of a woman named Shomer (Shimrith). Shomer is briefly mentioned in the Bible's genealogies as part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Shomer is listed as a son of Heber in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar, part of the genealogical lists in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Warriors of Issachar
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Issachar, including Shomer's lineage, counted brave warriors who were registered in the genealogical records.

keyEvents.title: Shomer's Sons
keyEvents.description: Shomer's children are listed as part of the genealogical overview of the tribe of Issachar in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Heber's Descendants
keyEvents.description: Shomer was one of several sons of Heber, and his lineage was preserved in Israel's tribal history as part of the tribe of Asher, which also mentions a Shomer.

keyEvents.title: Shomer's Connection to King Joash's Murder
keyEvents.description: Another Shomer (Shimrith) is mentioned as the mother of Josabad, one of those who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.
